description: A React functional component implementing a search input with associated logic, including event handlers, controlled input, and optional search options display.

classes.name: SearchBar
classes.description: React functional component providing a search bar interface with filtering and options display.

methods.name: onNoteFilterTextChange
methods.description: Updates the filter text in the item list controller when input changes.

methods.name: onNoteFilterKeyUp
methods.description: Handles keyup events in the input, triggering filter action on Enter key.

methods.name: onSearchFocus
methods.description: Sets focused state to true when search input gains focus.

methods.name: onSearchBlur
methods.description: Sets focused state to false when search input loses focus.

methods.name: onClearSearch
methods.description: Clears filter text and refocuses the search input.
